counter_evidence.text: The flag evidence does not prove the '100%' variant was in force at this onset: the paymentFailure impression step at 18:19 was predominantly variant "off" (off 891->913, +22) with only +1 on "100%" at 18:19 and +1 at 18:21, impressions appear only in short bursts rather than per charge, and flagd's actually-served flag configuration is not exposed by any available metric, so which variant payment used when PlaceOrder began failing is not directly observed.

fact.text: Alert condition reproduced: the checkout PlaceOrder server-span error ratio was 1.0 at every step from 18:23 to 18:26, 0.30 in the window ending 18:22, and 0 for all steps from 18:10 to 18:21.

Traffic volume behind that ratio is very low: the summed PlaceOrder server-span rate was ~0.0125-0.0167 spans/s between 18:15 and 18:26 (0.0137 spans/s at 18:15), so a 100% ratio reflects roughly one span per minute; checkout's error rate equalled its total rate over that period.

Every failing checkout PlaceOrder span in the sampled traces records otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with rpc.grpc.status_code=13, and its child oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge client span records rpc.grpc.status_code=2 with the description 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold'.

The error originates inside the payment service: payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (service payment, service_version 2.0.2) is status ERROR with grpc.error_name 'Error', grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace 'at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13) ... at async Object.chargeServiceHandler [as charge] (/usr/src/app/index.js:21:22)'.

payment rejects all charges rather than a fraction: for the window ending 18:26, payment's grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge SERVER span rate was 0.0125/s with status_code STATUS_CODE_ERROR and 0 with STATUS_CODE_UNSET, while the internal 'charge' span rate was also 0.0125/s.

payment's successful-charge counter confirms the stop: app_payment_transactions_total for app_payment_currency="USD" ran at ~0.0083-0.0208 per second up to 18:22 and read 0 at every step from 18:23 to 18:26; the small CAD series (0.0042/s) existed only during 18:12-18:15.

The same failure mode occurred earlier in the window: payment Charge spans sampled from 17:15-17:25 carry the identical grpc.error_message and identical charge.js:37 stacktrace, and checkout PlaceOrder server-span error rate was nonzero at every 5-minute step from 17:10 through 17:40 and exactly 0 from 17:45 through 18:21 before returning at ~18:22.

payment shows no saturation or unavailability signature: the failing Charge server spans completed in 1970-2206 us, payment has a single pod payment-6f7bc865d6-bfxbv whose image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:33f327b357617379bfa3b292f430d1f06e66e2872494125a40bae14d8fe57d87 is unchanged across 17:00-18:25, and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available for deployment payment was 1 at every step from 17:45 to 18:26.

checkout's pods were replaced at ~18:12 with an identical image digest: pod checkout-75c8bcd746-4m5rz was reported through 18:11 and pod checkout-5f6d95b5c7-ggksg from 18:12, both with image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635, and kube_deployment_status_replicas_available for deployment checkout stayed 1 throughout 17:45-18:26.

A PlaceOrder call still succeeded after that pod replacement: span 59c741f7f04dac92 (service checkout, operation oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder, start_us 1792865881237998 = 18:18:01) has rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with no error tags, its payment child oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge (5496dfc9b0f5b726) has rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and its HTTP POST child returned http.status_code=200.

flagd exposes a fault-injection flag named paymentFailure: at 18:26 feature_flag_flagd_impression_total had series for feature_flag_key="paymentFailure" with feature_flag_result_variant="off" (cumulative 913) and "100%" (cumulative 796), both with feature_flag_reason="STATIC", and feature_flag_flagd_result_reason_total for the same key (1685 at 18:12, 1709 at 18:22) carried only reason STATIC.

payment evaluates flags through flagd, and its evaluations are bursty and coincide with error-episode boundaries: payment's grpc.flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveFloat rate was nonzero only in windows covering ~17:09-17:12, ~17:39-17:42 and ~18:21-18:24 and 0 in every other step between 17:05 and 18:26; the paymentFailure impression counters stepped up at 17:09 (off 885->889, 100% 779->781), at 17:39 (off 889->891, 100% 781->794), and at 18:19/18:21 (off 891->913, 100% 794->796).

Propagated caller-side impact has its own error evidence in the sampled traces: frontend-proxy 'ingress' and 'router frontend egress' spans are ERROR with http.status_code 500, frontend 'POST', 'POST /api/checkout' and 'executing api route (pages) /api/checkout' spans are ERROR with http.status_code 500, and frontend's 'grpc.oteldemo.CheckoutService/PlaceOrder' client span is ERROR with rpc.grpc.status_code=13; the visible parent references chain ingress -> router frontend egress -> frontend POST -> POST /api/checkout -> executing api route -> frontend grpc PlaceOrder -> checkout PlaceOrder -> checkout client Charge -> payment server Charge within those sampled traces.

Other services on the PlaceOrder path show no error evidence of their own in the sampled traces: shipping oteldemo.ShippingService/GetQuote returned rpc.grpc.status_code=0 with HTTP 200, currency Currency/Convert returned otel.status_code="OK"/rpc.grpc.status_code=0, and cart GetCart, product-catalog oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct and quote POST /getquote were error-free; the by-service ERROR-rate query for 17:00-18:26 returned zero-valued series for ad, cart, product-catalog, recommendation and shipping operations.

The email service shows no error status in this window (POST /send_order_confirmation, send_email and sinatra.render_template all STATUS_CODE_UNSET), but its span rate fell from 0.0125/s (window ending 18:16) to 0.0083/s (18:21) and 0 (18:26), consistent with PlaceOrder aborting at the charge step before the confirmation-email step.

The load generator did not restart or change during the window: pod load-generator-d94d4b8d7-hx8hn with image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:d257288d374e1f6ebceb9997049fd4a31437037e85fc6dccaedd0c4810e1ca11 is reported unchanged at every 5-minute step from 17:00 to 18:25, while PlaceOrder traffic stayed roughly constant at ~0.0125-0.0137 spans/s.

hypothesis.text: Primary hypothesis: payment's charge handler is being driven into its fault-injection path, so it rejects every charge with the 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' error thrown at charge.js:37, and checkout's PlaceOrder fails only because that dependency call returns Unknown/2. Support: payment returns a deterministic application-level Error in ~2 ms with no outbound child span, 100% of Charge server spans are ERROR with 0 successful transactions from 18:23, payment's pod/image and replica availability never changed, flagd serves a paymentFailure flag whose variants are 'off' and '100%', and payment's flag re-evaluations plus paymentFailure counter steps fall at the start/stop boundaries of both error episodes (17:09/17:39 for the first, ~18:19-18:21 for the current one).

Alternative hypothesis still open: the invalid card token originates in the request data (checkout or load-generator card/token handling) rather than in a payment-side switch, which would produce the same payment-side rejection. It is unresolved by metrics and only weakly supported, because the same client path and unchanged load-generator pod produced a fully successful PlaceOrder at 18:18:01 and the error is thrown inside payment's own code.

rejected_hypothesis.text: The operator's lead that the otel-demo/checkout rollout rel-20261024181103 at 2026-10-24T18:11:03Z caused this alert is not supported. The replacement appears configuration-only to the extent the evidence shows (new pod checkout-5f6d95b5c7-ggksg at 18:12 with the identical image_id sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635), the identical 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' error with the charge.js:37 stacktrace already occurred at 17:15-17:25 well before the rollout, checkout's error rate was 0 from 17:45 to 18:21 including the first ~9 minutes after the new pod appeared, and PlaceOrder still succeeded at 18:18:01 on that post-rollout pod before failing from ~18:21.

Payment resource saturation, latency or unavailability as the failing mechanism is rejected by the evidence: the failing Charge server spans completed in 1970-2206 us carrying grpc.error_name 'Error' and gRPC status 2/Unknown (an application-level error, not deadline-exceeded or unavailable), payment's deployment had 1 available replica at every step 17:45-18:26 with an unchanged pod image, and the separate paymentUnreachable flag appears in flagd impressions only with variant "off", so an unreachable-payment path was not in use.

A failing downstream dependency inside payment as the cause is rejected: in the sampled error traces payment's Charge server span has only the internal 'charge' span as its visible child and no outbound client span, and the exception originates in payment's own file /usr/src/app/charge.js:37, so the rejection is decided locally in payment rather than produced by a call payment makes.

The email service shows no error status in this window (POST /send_order_confirmation, send_email and sinatra.render_template all STATUS_CODE_UNSET), but its span rate fell from 0.0125/s (window ending 18:16) to 0.0083/s (18:21) and 0 (18:26), consistent with PlaceOrder aborting at the charge step before the confirmation-email step.

The load generator did not restart or change during the window: pod load-generator-d94d4b8d7-hx8hn with image_id ghcr.io/open-telemetry/demo@sha256:d257288d374e1f6ebceb9997049fd4a31437037e85fc6dccaedd0c4810e1ca11 is reported unchanged at every 5-minute step from 17:00 to 18:25, while PlaceOrder traffic stayed roughly constant at ~0.0125-0.0137 spans/s.

Primary hypothesis: payment's charge handler is being driven into its fault-injection path, so it rejects every charge with the 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' error thrown at charge.js:37, and checkout's PlaceOrder fails only because that dependency call returns Unknown/2. Support: payment returns a deterministic application-level Error in ~2 ms with no outbound child span, 100% of Charge server spans are ERROR with 0 successful transactions from 18:23, payment's pod/image and replica availability never changed, flagd serves a paymentFailure flag whose variants are 'off' and '100%', and payment's flag re-evaluations plus paymentFailure counter steps fall at the start/stop boundaries of both error episodes (17:09/17:39 for the first, ~18:19-18:21 for the current one).

Alternative hypothesis still open: the invalid card token originates in the request data (checkout or load-generator card/token handling) rather than in a payment-side switch, which would produce the same payment-side rejection. It is unresolved by metrics and only weakly supported, because the same client path and unchanged load-generator pod produced a fully successful PlaceOrder at 18:18:01 and the error is thrown inside payment's own code.

The flag evidence does not prove the '100%' variant was in force at this onset: the paymentFailure impression step at 18:19 was predominantly variant "off" (off 891->913, +22) with only +1 on "100%" at 18:19 and +1 at 18:21, impressions appear only in short bursts rather than per charge, and flagd's actually-served flag configuration is not exposed by any available metric, so which variant payment used when PlaceOrder began failing is not directly observed.

The operator's lead that the otel-demo/checkout rollout rel-20261024181103 at 2026-10-24T18:11:03Z caused this alert is not supported. The replacement appears configuration-only to the extent the evidence shows (new pod checkout-5f6d95b5c7-ggksg at 18:12 with the identical image_id sha256:5ab0d7b9003206a32c72ef48b42a535c3f70565251d7d832f86fe9f249f16635), the identical 'Payment request failed. Invalid token.' error with the charge.js:37 stacktrace already occurred at 17:15-17:25 well before the rollout, checkout's error rate was 0 from 17:45 to 18:21 including the first ~9 minutes after the new pod appeared, and PlaceOrder still succeeded at 18:18:01 on that post-rollout pod before failing from ~18:21.

Payment resource saturation, latency or unavailability as the failing mechanism is rejected by the evidence: the failing Charge server spans completed in 1970-2206 us carrying grpc.error_name 'Error' and gRPC status 2/Unknown (an application-level error, not deadline-exceeded or unavailable), payment's deployment had 1 available replica at every step 17:45-18:26 with an unchanged pod image, and the separate paymentUnreachable flag appears in flagd impressions only with variant "off", so an unreachable-payment path was not in use.

A failing downstream dependency inside payment as the cause is rejected: in the sampled error traces payment's Charge server span has only the internal 'charge' span as its visible child and no outbound client span, and the exception originates in payment's own file /usr/src/app/charge.js:37, so the rejection is decided locally in payment rather than produced by a call payment makes.

gaps: change_history is not an integrated source in this Run, so what changed the flagd paymentFailure flag value or flagd flag configuration at ~17:09, ~17:39 and ~18:19-18:21, and who changed it, cannot be verified.

The content of the checkout rollout rel-20261024181103 (2026-10-24T18:11:03Z) is unknown: no config, env-var or ConfigMap data is available to confirm what changed beyond the pod replacement with an identical image digest.
kubernetes_state and pod_logs are not integrated, so payment and checkout container logs, restarts and pod events around 18:18-18:22 could not be inspected.

flagd's served flag configuration and per-client variant decisions are not exposed by available metrics; only small, bursty aggregate impression counters per variant exist, mixed between 'off' and '100%' at the current onset.

The query rpc_server_duration_milliseconds_count{service_name="payment"} returned no_data, so payment gRPC status-code distributions could not be confirmed from that metric; gRPC code evidence comes only from span status tags.

Trace evidence is a sampled view: the payment and mixed-service trace searches each reported incomplete=true because the backend returned as many traces as requested, and the checkout span read was truncated (45 of 218 rows returned), so the visible parent-child chains describe sampled traces rather than a complete call graph.

Whether end customers were affected beyond the observed frontend and frontend-proxy HTTP 500 responses is unverified; no user-facing SLO or business-success metric other than app_payment_transactions_total was examined.
No comparable latency baseline was established for payment's charge path, so span durations are reported as observed values only and no latency trend is claimed.

report.summary: The alert is reproduced: the otel-demo checkout PlaceOrder server-span error ratio was 1.0 at every step from 18:23 to 18:26 (0.30 in the window ending 18:22, 0 from 18:10 to 18:21) on very low volume (summed PlaceOrder server-span rate ~0.0125-0.0167 spans/s, so span counts are not request counts). Every sampled failing PlaceOrder span carries otel.status_description 'failed to charge card: could not charge the card: rpc error: code = Unknown desc = Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' with rpc.grpc.status_code=13, and the error is thrown inside the payment service: payment's own server span grpc.oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge is ERROR with grpc.error_message 'Payment request failed. Invalid token. app.loyalty.level=gold' and exception.stacktrace 'at module.exports.charge (/usr/src/app/charge.js:37:13)'. payment's Charge SERVER span rate of 0.0125/s was entirely STATUS_CODE_ERROR with 0 STATUS_CODE_UNSET, and its successful-charge counter app_payment_transactions_total (USD) fell from ~0.0083-0.0208/s to 0 from 18:23, so payment rejects every charge through its own fast (~2 ms) application code path with no outbound child span. checkout, frontend and frontend-proxy each carry their own propagated error spans (gRPC 13/Unknown, HTTP 500). The same error text and charge.js:37 stacktrace appear in an earlier episode (sampled 17:15-17:25; PlaceOrder error rate nonzero 17:10-17:40, exactly 0 from 17:45 to 18:21), so this is a recurring all-or-nothing payment rejection. The operator's rollout lead (rel-20261024181103 at 18:11:03Z) is not supported: the new checkout pod kept the identical image digest (config-only change), PlaceOrder still succeeded at 18:18:01 on that post-rollout pod, and the identical failure existed before the rollout. A plausible trigger is flagd's fault-injection flag 'paymentFailure' (variants 'off' and '100%'), whose payment-side re-evaluations and counter steps bracket both error episodes, but the impression counters at this onset are dominated by the 'off' variant, so that link remains a hypothesis with counter-evidence.
